children: (“GLPI”) today announced it has entered into definitive agreements to form a joint venture with Prologis, Inc.
(“Prologis”) to develop the former Hollywood Casino Joliet site.

GLPI will contribute the 262-acre parcel at 777 Hollywood Boulevard in Joliet, Illinois to the joint venture in three phases, and Prologis will serve as the managing member and developer of the site. Prologis intends to develop the site, subject to the review and approval by the City of Joliet, into a modern Class A warehouse and distribution park, which, when completed, is currently anticipated to consist of five building structures totaling more than 3.8 million square feet. The project is expected to be developed over approximately five years, in three phases, with Prologis holding options over the development of phases two and three.

The transaction represents the first joint venture for GLPI, and the expansion into the industrial / logistics space marks the first investment outside of the gaming sector. The transaction will transition the former Hollywood Joliet site, which was vacated in September of 2025 by Penn Entertainment, Inc. after it opened the new Hollywood Joliet property, into a productive industrial use complex in one of the nation’s premier logistics corridors along Interstate 80.

Peter Carlino, GLPI’s Chairman and CEO, commented, “We are pleased to partner with Prologis, a leader in the logistics real estate space, in this joint venture. We see considerable value in this development, as we contribute and monetize our expansive Joliet land parcel, and benefit from the expertise of Prologis in the development of this coveted site.”

“We are excited to partner with GLPI on this project. The site offers exceptional location and access, and we see a strong opportunity to create a modern logistics campus that supports the local economy and businesses looking to operate in Joliet,” said Josh Zemon, SVP and Investment Officer, Prologis. “We look forward to working with GLPI, the City of Joliet, and the community as we move through the development process.”

GLPI is engaged in the business of acquiring, financing, and owning real estate property to be leased to gaming operators in triple-net lease arrangements, pursuant to which the tenant is responsible for all facility maintenance, insurance required in connection with the leased properties and the business conducted on the leased properties, taxes levied on or with respect to the leased properties and all utilities and other services necessary or appropriate for the leased properties and the business conducted on the leased properties.
